events.install_click: Chrome Web Store button (install or reinstall)
events.select_content: Link to a tool landing or a free web tool on getlineapps.com
events.outbound_click: Any other link that leaves getlineapps.com (GitHub, ad libraries)
events.nav_click: In-page jump link (header menu, hero buttons)
events.feature_tab_view: Feature tab picked on a landing
events.role_filter: Role filter on the hub tool cards
events.checkpoint_view: Check point picked on the hub example page
events.web_tool_use: Free web tool used (SERP preview, ad library finder)
events.section_view: A page section was at least half on screen (once per page)
events.scroll_depth: Page scrolled to 25, 50, 75 or 90 percent (once each)
events.cookie_settings_open: Cookie settings link in the footer
